title: The Ball-Covering Property in Lipschitz-Free Spaces
summary: We study ball-covering properties in Lipschitz-free spaces. We establish an extension criterion for proving that $\mathcal F(M)$ fails the ball-covering property and apply it to several classes of nonseparable metric spaces. In contrast, we construct a nonseparable uniformly discrete metric space $M$ such that $\mathcal F(M)$ has the uniform ball-covering property and is isomorphic to $\ell_1(2^ω)$.
